## **Full-Service Custom Aluminum Extrusions**

*1850-Ton Fully Automated 7" Extrusion Press*

### **Full-Service Extrusion Capabilities**

#### **Extrusions, Inc. is a full-service aluminum extruder featuring a large inventory of stock
#### dies and thousands of custom shapes for all types of aluminum products.****  **

Extrusions has two extrusions presses, a fabrication department, three CNC machines, a state of the
art powder coat paint line, pour and debridge machinery, polyamide strut insertion machinery, and in
house anodizing.  Our vertical integration allows us to produce the finest quality aluminum
extrusions with competitive lead times. 

Centrally located in Fort Scott, KS, Extrusions offers all the services of a larger extruder, but
hasn’t lost the ability to treat customers like a small business.  With more than 120,000 square
feet of production space and over 100 employees Extrusions can accommodate high volume orders or the
one-time order.  You can rely on Extrusions’ experienced and dedicated employees to meet your need
for aluminum extrusions. 

Since 1962 flexibility and creativity has made Extrusions, Inc a service oriented company.  Meeting
customers’ unique needs has been our #1 priority and has been responsible for our consistent growth
and success. 

Unlike some of our competitors, all the services we offer are located in our facility which allows
us to oversee and handle your products from start to finish in house.  Having a vertically
integrated business model allows us to provide exceptional customer service, better responsiveness,
excellent products, and safe shipping.

Combine this with our press capacity, finishing services, fabrication department, thermal
improvement options, and CNC capabilities and our customers have a turnkey production resource to
help your business with all your aluminum extrusions needs. 

[ Learn More ][32]

### **Sustainability**

Extrusions, Inc. is dedicated to operating its facility as environmentally friendly as possible.  To
learn more follow this link to Extrusions Inc.’s [LEED Statement][33].

Custom Aluminum Extrusions

Aluminum Fabrication

Aluminum Finishing Services

**Who We Are**

When it comes to custom aluminum extrusions, if it can be imagined, then it’s something we can bring
to life.  We understand there are going to be times when flexibility, innovation, and real person to
person access and interaction is a necessity.  That’s why we make it our priority to work closely
with clients to offer collaborative and inventive problem solving solutions for your projects.  Our
team at Extrusions, Inc., with over 100 years of combined industry experience, are your custom
design specialists.

Our biggest asset is our people that add a personal element to all our interactions.  From first
contact to shipment, it’s the sense that our people genuinely care about your business needs.  This
has led to life-long customers who come back again and again.  You can relax knowing that your
business is in the hands of an experienced team of people who care about your product. 

## **Contact us today and discover how we can help you with your extrusion, fabrication, and
## finishing needs from start to finish.**

[ Give Us A Call ][34]

## 
## **Get a Quote**

**When you need a simple shape, a complex hollow or a highly customized profile, Extrusions, Inc.,
can extrude it. **

**We have nearly 60 years of experience providing extruded aluminum to markets across the Midwest
and the United States. We look forward to helping you!**

[
][35] [
][36] [
][37]

"To our valued customers,

At Extrusions, Inc. our goal is to provide superior products of exceptional value to our customers.
Since 1963 we have been meeting customers’ needs and providing the quality necessary for them to
attain a competitive edge in their marketplace. Attention to operational excellence and innovation
processes are our keystone to continued growth and longevity."

**Sincerely,
Matt Ida, Owner**

Toll Free (800) 295-3113 
Phone (620) 223-1111 
FAX (620) 223-1139

2401 South Main Street
Fort Scott, Kansas 66701

# Expert HVAC, Plumbing, and Electrical Services

## Licensed, Bonded, and Insured Home Service Professionals Across the Country

**Since 1996**, Service Experts has been the trusted name for comprehensive HVAC repair, plumbing,
and electrical services across North America. **We serve over 800,000 homes** and have nearly **20k
5-star reviews online**. 

When your heater stops working on the coldest night or your AC fails during a heat wave, our expert
technicians deliver fast, reliable solutions that keep your home running smoothly.

Our nationwide network of **ACE-certified professionals** specializes in all areas of home comfort
and safety. Whether you need an electrician for a panel upgrade, urgent AC repair, or a plumber to
fix a leak, Service Experts has you covered. 

With **licensed**, **bonded**, and **insured **professionals, **24/7 scheduling and customer
service**, and convenient memberships, we make managing your home simple.

## Find a Local Expert Ready to Help

What sets Service Experts apart is our unique combination of local expertise and national support.
Our technicians live and work in your community, so they understand the specific climate conditions
and home service needs that come with your region. Whether it's heat pumps and mini-split systems
commonly used in the Northeast, advanced water treatment solutions needed in the Southwest, or
traditional central AC units typical in Texas and Florida, we tailor our recommendations to what
works best in your area.

and safety. Whether you need an electrician for a panel upgrade, urgent AC repair, or a plumber to
fix a leak, Service Experts has you covered. 

With **licensed**, **bonded**, and **insured **professionals, **24/7 scheduling and customer
service**, and convenient memberships, we make managing your home simple.

Our technicians live and work in your community, so they understand the specific climate conditions
and home service needs that come with your region. Whether it's heat pumps and mini-split systems
commonly used in the Northeast, advanced water treatment solutions needed in the Southwest, or
traditional central AC units typical in Texas and Florida, we tailor our recommendations to what
works best in your area.

## FAQ

Apexplast
Are you a factory or trading company?

We’re a real factory. Apexplast has its own production lines and QC team. No middlemen, full
control.

What exactly is acrylic sheet?

Acrylic sheet, also known as PMMA sheet or organic glass, is a type of plastic with the chemical
name polymethyl methacrylate. widely used in signage, displays, and furniture.

How’s your product quality?

High-grade raw materials, strict inspection, stable quality. Exported to 120+ countries.

Do you support custom branding?

Yes. Custom logo film and packaging available to help build your brand.

What types do you offer?

Cast, extruded, and mirror acrylic sheets. Multiple colors and finishes available.

Which markets do you export to?

Global supply. Strong presence in Southeast Asia, Middle East, Europe, and South America.

## Why Partner with Us

Aircraft Extrusion Co. was founded in 2015 on values of precision, innovation, and trust. We're
dedicated to delivering aerospace solutions with exceptional care, expertise, and a commitment to
your success.

[Quality You Can Trust]

### Quality You Can Trust

Built on ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100:2016 certifications, our defect rates beat industry
standards—delivering reliable components every time.

[Access Over 40,000 Parts]

### Access Over 40,000 Parts

With 2,000+ items in stock and a searchable database of 40,000+ part numbers, we’ve got the
aerospace solutions you need, ready to ship.

[Serving Leaders Since 2015]

### Serving Leaders Since 2015

Founded by industry veteran Michael Sealey, we supply top names like Boeing and SpaceX with
precision extrusions and custom designs.

[DISCOVER OUR STORY][18]

## What's New

#### New in 2024: allsafe Partnership

We are excited to announce that Aircraft Extrusion Company is now a stocking distributor for allsafe
products. Designed and manufactured in Germany, allsafe offers a wide range of track fittings that
complement our selection of extruded aircraft shapes.

[SEAT FITTINGS][19][STRAPS & NETS][20]
[who-we-are]

## Who We Are and
## What We Do

Aircraft Extrusion Company was founded to solve a problem in the aviation industry—how to get
high-performance alloy extrusions faster and more efficiently. Based in Chico, California, we stock
a large range of aerospace shapes, including seat tracks, hat sections, and hinge extrusions.

With a 10,000 sq ft facility and an online database of over 40,000 part numbers, we make it easy to
search, cross-reference, and identify the right part. Backed by AS9100 and ISO9001 certifications,
our focus is on delivering quality and reliability in every order.

[LEARN MORE][21]

For inquiries or to learn more about our products and services, please contact us. We look forward

As experienced partners of the automobile and automotive suppliers’ industries, we are familiar with
the requirements of this sector. Our extruders play a vital part in shaping both vehicle interiors
and car body work.

[Learn more][77]

### Construction industry

Economical, energy-efficient and safe: our extrusion lines prove their effectiveness daily around
the world in applications for the building industry, for example in the production of window and
door profiles, technical profiles and pipes.

[Learn more][78]

### Chemicals & recycling

We support our customers in the chemical and recycling industries with customized solutions for
demanding applications. For extrusion technology which leaves nothing to be desired in terms of
process reliability and sustainability.

[Learn more][79]

### Electrical industry

On battenfeld-cincinnati process technology, our customers produce effective cable conduit pipes for
high-voltage, news, control and communication cables as well as power supply lines. We manufacture
all our systems according to your specifications.

[Learn more][80]

### Energy

From mining, oil and natural gas extraction to the solar industry: extrusion technology from
battenfeld-cincinnati is operating successfully in many different fields of the energy sector.

[Learn more][81]

### Food

As a technology leader in the extrusion industry, we develop extrusion solutions and processes that
process the sensitive basic ingredients of food production even more gently, safely and sustainably.

[Learn more][82]

### Packaging

Our extruders produce application-optimized sheet for the packaging industry from PP, PS, PET and
PVC, for example sheet for boxes, blister packages and sleeves. We invariably develop our extrusion
technology exactly to your specifications.

[Learn more][83]

### Water management

Water and sewerage pipes manufactured on extrusion lines from our company recommend themselves not
only by their price/performance ratio. Their long service life also makes them attractive for public
and private building projects of every kind.

[Learn more][84]

### Pipe

battenfeld-cincinnati offers complete extrusion lines and customized solutions made to measure for
pipe extrusion applications. Whether made of PO, PVC or other types of plastic: we will advise you
expertly in selecting the optimal material.

[Learn more][85]

### Profile

We are your experienced partners for planning, designing and manufacturing profile extrusion lines
made to measure. Your advantages: high output, outstanding energy efficiency and first-class product
quality.

[Learn more][86]

### Sheet and board

battenfeld-cincinnati offers complete production lines for the extrusion of compact PVC boards, free
foam sheet, coextruded multilayer boards and technical boards. Functional. Economical. With maximum
reliability.

[Learn more][87]

### Film and sheet

We are your partners for sheet extrusion lines from a single source, offering sustainable high-speed
technology to meet the rising energy and material costs in sheet extrusion.

[Learn more][88]

### Pelletizing

For PVC pelletizing, battenfeld-cincinnati offers twin screw extruders and planetary roller
extruders combined with hot die face pelletizing. Single screw extruders are used for other
thermoplastic materials.

[Learn more][89]

### Extruders

We develop and manufacture energy-efficient and resource-saving extruders for a great variety of
applications. Your advantages: top quality, outstanding performance and reliable homogenization.

[Learn more][90]

### Tooling

The optimal extrusion die solution for every application: for our extrusion lines, we will supply
you with the matching forming tools. Our pipe dies are developed, adjusted and optimized in-house.

[Learn more][91]

### Downstream & Systems

in addition to the extruder and die, a complete extrusion line also includes downstream equipment.
Our downstream components contribute substantially to quality assurance, resource saving and the
reduction of the energy consumption.

[Learn more][92]

### Controls & Automation

Our control and automation concepts simplify operation and make it possible to control the
consumption of energy and resources. With our FDC line concept, you can switch over inline to a
different pipe diameter by just one click.

[Learn more][93]

only by their price/performance ratio. Their long service life also makes them attractive for public
and private building projects of every kind.

[Learn more][84]

### Pipe

battenfeld-cincinnati offers complete extrusion lines and customized solutions made to measure for
pipe extrusion applications. Whether made of PO, PVC or other types of plastic: we will advise you
expertly in selecting the optimal material.

[Learn more][85]

### Profile

We are your experienced partners for planning, designing and manufacturing profile extrusion lines
made to measure. Your advantages: high output, outstanding energy efficiency and first-class product
quality.

[Learn more][86]

### Sheet and board

battenfeld-cincinnati offers complete production lines for the extrusion of compact PVC boards, free
foam sheet, coextruded multilayer boards and technical boards. Functional. Economical. With maximum
reliability.

[Learn more][87]

### Film and sheet

We are your partners for sheet extrusion lines from a single source, offering sustainable high-speed
technology to meet the rising energy and material costs in sheet extrusion.

[Learn more][88]

### Pelletizing

For PVC pelletizing, battenfeld-cincinnati offers twin screw extruders and planetary roller
extruders combined with hot die face pelletizing. Single screw extruders are used for other
thermoplastic materials.

[Learn more][89]

### Extruders

We develop and manufacture energy-efficient and resource-saving extruders for a great variety of
applications. Your advantages: top quality, outstanding performance and reliable homogenization.

[Learn more][90]

### Tooling

The optimal extrusion die solution for every application: for our extrusion lines, we will supply
you with the matching forming tools. Our pipe dies are developed, adjusted and optimized in-house.

[Learn more][91]

### Downstream & Systems

in addition to the extruder and die, a complete extrusion line also includes downstream equipment.
Our downstream components contribute substantially to quality assurance, resource saving and the
reduction of the energy consumption.

[Learn more][92]

### Controls & Automation

Our control and automation concepts simplify operation and make it possible to control the
consumption of energy and resources. With our FDC line concept, you can switch over inline to a
different pipe diameter by just one click.

solutions to the most challenging mono- and multi-layer film and sheet applications. The

manufacture custom plastic extrusion products to meet even the most aggressive commercial deadlines.

let us evaluate your custom application requirements today.

Established in 1988, the company is promoted by Late Shri M. P. Jhunjhunwala, a first generation
entrepreneur. The Company is one of India’s largest aluminium extrusion manufacturer. CEL’s
production facility is located at Kharagpur (West Bengal) in eastern part of India, close to leading
primary aluminium manufacturers in India. With an experience spanning a rich 35 years, CEL enjoys a
number of first mover advantages comprising a comprehensive understanding of the aluminum and
aluminum extrusions market, reputed brand, low historical asset cost and a strong customer
base among others.

## How to Verify a GST Number

A valid GSTIN (Goods & Services Tax Identification Number) confirms a business is registered to
collect GST. Always verify before making B2B payments.
1. Go to **gst.gov.in** — no login required
2. Click *Search Taxpayer* → *Search by GSTIN / UIN*
3. Enter the **15-character GSTIN** and solve the CAPTCHA
4. Check the **Registration Status** — must show *Active*
5. Verify the **Legal Name** matches your vendor/supplier

How to read a GSTIN
27 AABCU9603R 1 Z 5
■ State code ■ PAN (10) ■ Entity ■ Z ■ Check
A **cancelled** or **suspended** GSTIN means the business cannot charge GST — input tax credit
claims will be disallowed.

## Pvt Ltd vs LLP — Key Differences

Choosing the right business structure affects taxation, liability, compliance burden, and investor
readiness. Here's a quick comparison.

─────────────────┬───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────
Factor           │Pvt Ltd                    │LLP                  
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Liability        │Limited                    │Limited              
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Min. Members     │2 directors, 2 shareholders│2 designated partners
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Tax Rate         │22% (base)                 │30% (flat)           
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Annual Filings   │Higher — ROC + IT + audit  │Lower — MCA + IT     
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Equity / VC      │✔ Allowed                  │✘ Not allowed        
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Foreign Ownership│✔ FDI allowed              │Limited routes       
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Startup India    │✔ Eligible                 │✔ Eligible           
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Cost to Set Up   │₹6,000–₹15,000             │₹3,000–₹8,000        
─────────────────┴───────────────────────────┴─────────────────────
Choose **Pvt Ltd** if you plan to raise funding. Choose **LLP** for professional services firms with
lower compliance needs.

## How to Check Company Status on MCA

The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) portal lets you verify any registered Indian company's
status in seconds — for free.
1. Visit **mca.gov.in** and click *MCA Services*
2. Select *View Company / LLP Master Data*
3. Enter the **CIN** (Corporate Identity Number) or company name
4. Click *Submit* to see the master data

**Active** — company is in good standing and filing compliances

**Under Liquidation** — winding-up proceedings ongoing

You can also search any company instantly on **companydetails.in** without visiting MCA directly.

## How to Verify a GST Number

A valid GSTIN (Goods & Services Tax Identification Number) confirms a business is registered to
collect GST. Always verify before making B2B payments.
1. Go to **gst.gov.in** — no login required
2. Click *Search Taxpayer* → *Search by GSTIN / UIN*
3. Enter the **15-character GSTIN** and solve the CAPTCHA
4. Check the **Registration Status** — must show *Active*
5. Verify the **Legal Name** matches your vendor/supplier

How to read a GSTIN
27 AABCU9603R 1 Z 5
■ State code ■ PAN (10) ■ Entity ■ Z ■ Check
A **cancelled** or **suspended** GSTIN means the business cannot charge GST — input tax credit
claims will be disallowed.

## Pvt Ltd vs LLP — Key Differences

Choosing the right business structure affects taxation, liability, compliance burden, and investor
readiness. Here's a quick comparison.

─────────────────┬───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────
Factor           │Pvt Ltd                    │LLP                  
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Liability        │Limited                    │Limited              
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Min. Members     │2 directors, 2 shareholders│2 designated partners
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Tax Rate         │22% (base)                 │30% (flat)           
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Annual Filings   │Higher — ROC + IT + audit  │Lower — MCA + IT     
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Equity / VC      │✔ Allowed                  │✘ Not allowed        
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Foreign Ownership│✔ FDI allowed              │Limited routes       
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Startup India    │✔ Eligible                 │✔ Eligible           
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Cost to Set Up   │₹6,000–₹15,000             │₹3,000–₹8,000        
─────────────────┴───────────────────────────┴─────────────────────
Choose **Pvt Ltd** if you plan to raise funding. Choose **LLP** for professional services firms with
lower compliance needs.

###### WHO WE ARE

## COOPER PLASTICS: A LEADING CUSTOM PLASTIC MANUFACTURER

###### Established 2023

Cooper Plastics is a custom plastic manufacturer headquartered just outside of Chicago in Whiting,
Indiana. Our company was established in 2023 as a custom manufacturing division of PolyJohn
Enterprises Corporation, a leading, worldwide manufacturer of high-quality portable sanitation
equipment. We specialize in transforming thermoplastic materials into dependable plastic parts and
products.

###### Quality & Consistency

We use state-of-the-art machines and excel at every aspect of the manufacturing process from raw
thermoplastic material to finished product. We only utilize the industry’s best plastic materials
and cutting-edge equipment to transform it to exact specifications. This level of quality control
enables us to manufacture consistent, high-quality plastic products, every time!

[resize-Pellets]
[resize-Machine]
[Thermoforming]

###### Experienced Team

Our team possesses decades of experience in the plastics manufacturing sector. We not only employ
knowledgeable machinists who keep our production process running efficiently but also product
designers and engineers who empower us to innovate and provide custom solutions for our customers’
unique needs. The experts at Cooper Plastics are second to none and ensure our custom plastic
fabrications meet and exceed all expectations.

###### Family-Owned & Operated

Cooper Plastics is a proud family-owned and operated business. Our CEO, Sam Cooper, is a
third-generation business owner who possesses a wealth of knowledge about plastics manufacturing and
uses it to guide our company to provide customers with quality products and exceptional customer
service. Our business operates plants in Indiana, Michigan, and Ontario to serve customers
throughout the United States and Canada.
[ Learn More ][34]

## OUR CUSTOM PLASTICS FABRICATION CAPABILITIES

At Cooper Plastics, we offer numerous plastic fabrication methods to meet the unique needs of our
clients. From complex, innovative designs to large-scale production, our manufacturing process is
designed to take your projects from concept to reality with precision and efficiency. Explore our
diverse plastic manufacturing capabilities below!

[Sheet Extrusion]

## [Sheet Extrusion][35]

Raw plastic material (resin) is processed into flat sheets that can be used in other plastic
manufacturing processes.

[Thermoforming]

## [Thermoforming][36]

Heat and pressure are used to force plastic sheets into a mold and transform them into the end
product.

[Rotational Molding]

## [Rotational Molding][37]

In this process, also known as rotomolding, the mold is rotated vertically and horizontally in an
oven to produce hollow plastic products.

[Injection Molding]

## [Injection Molding][38]

Molten plastic is injected into the mold to produce durable plastic products and minimize scrap
material.

## [Blow Molding][39]

Compressed air is blown into a plastic tube (parison/preform) within the mold to produce hollow

[Xometry Resources]

#### Industry-specific Experience

Our precision applications are perfect for aerospace, defense, automotive, medical, robotics,
industrial, consumer electronics industries, and many more. We offer CoCs, material certifications,
finishing certifications, inspection reports, and hardware certifications.

## Maximize Collaboration with Teamspace

Collaborating with others on your manufacturing projects has never been easier with Teamspace. It is
a feature within your Xometry account that allows you to easily work with other users on projects
and custom part orders. Teams simplify purchasing workflows. For instance, you can get an instant
quote on your [personal dashboard][108], and when you’re ready to order, share the quote with an
entire purchasing or procurement team you’ve made. Teamspace provides a unified Xometry experience,
giving your team members quick and easy access to quotes, order placement, part statuses, tracking
information, and more. You can [create a Team today][109] or click here to [learn more about how
Teamspace works][110].

[Xometry Resources]

## We’re Your Partner From Prototyping to Production and Beyond

Xometry offers a range of solutions to help you develop practical prototypes and scale up to
production parts. Make custom parts on demand using more than 70 materials across over 20 processes.
Put our network of over 10,000 highly vetted manufacturers and our skilled applications engineering
team to work for you.

Xometry Instant Quoting Engine®

Get quotes within seconds on CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal fabrication, urethane casting,
and more. Upload a 3D CAD file and receive the price, lead time, and design-for-manufacturing
feedback instantly.

Injection Molding Services

Xometry delivers high-quality, on-demand injection molding for prototypes and production parts.
Dozens of materials, insert molding, compression molding, silicone rubber molding, and more options
are available. Learn more about [Xometry's Injection Molding Service][111].

Assembly and Weldments

Xometry adds value through its massive global supply chain and secondary services like assembly or
weldments. The team can create, kit, and provide turnkey products to your specifications.

New to Xometry? Get started with a [quote][112].

## Metal and Plastic Production Solutions

Xometry’s digital manufacturing marketplace is your one-stop solution for production. Our team is
the perfect solution for your product manufacturing needs with our staff of technical experts, ease
of our secure quoting platform, and global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry offers competitive pricing and lead times on [plastic injection molding][113], [die
casting][114], [metal stamping][115], [metal extrusion][116], [plastic extrusion][117], [sheet
metal][118], [laser cutting][119], [waterjet cutting][120], [laser tube cutting][121], and [tube
bending][122] services. [Start your quote][123] or [contact us][124] today to begin.

[Xometry Resources]

## Choose Your Optimal Price and Lead Time

The [Xometry Instant Quoting Engine®][125] makes it easy to upload a CAD file and compare prices and
lead times in just a few clicks. With thousands of manufacturing suppliers in all 50 U.S. states and
more than 20 countries, Xometry’s extensive network gives you options to choose the shipping
timeline and price that fit your business and budget. 

Xometry offers [price matching][126] and a 30-day price guarantee on quotes, giving you peace of
mind that you’re getting the best price. When [ordering prototypes][127] — originals or models of
parts that are intended exclusively for non-commercial purposes — the price shown at checkout
includes tariffs. Shipping is also included, as long as your package is standard-size.

quote on your [personal dashboard][108], and when you’re ready to order, share the quote with an
entire purchasing or procurement team you’ve made. Teamspace provides a unified Xometry experience,
giving your team members quick and easy access to quotes, order placement, part statuses, tracking
information, and more. You can [create a Team today][109] or click here to [learn more about how
Teamspace works][110].

[Xometry Resources]

## We’re Your Partner From Prototyping to Production and Beyond

Xometry offers a range of solutions to help you develop practical prototypes and scale up to
production parts. Make custom parts on demand using more than 70 materials across over 20 processes.
Put our network of over 10,000 highly vetted manufacturers and our skilled applications engineering
team to work for you.

Xometry Instant Quoting Engine®

Get quotes within seconds on CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal fabrication, urethane casting,
and more. Upload a 3D CAD file and receive the price, lead time, and design-for-manufacturing
feedback instantly.

Injection Molding Services

Xometry delivers high-quality, on-demand injection molding for prototypes and production parts.
Dozens of materials, insert molding, compression molding, silicone rubber molding, and more options
are available. Learn more about [Xometry's Injection Molding Service][111].

Assembly and Weldments

Xometry adds value through its massive global supply chain and secondary services like assembly or
weldments. The team can create, kit, and provide turnkey products to your specifications.

New to Xometry? Get started with a [quote][112].

## Metal and Plastic Production Solutions

Xometry’s digital manufacturing marketplace is your one-stop solution for production. Our team is
the perfect solution for your product manufacturing needs with our staff of technical experts, ease
of our secure quoting platform, and global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry offers competitive pricing and lead times on [plastic injection molding][113], [die
casting][114], [metal stamping][115], [metal extrusion][116], [plastic extrusion][117], [sheet
metal][118], [laser cutting][119], [waterjet cutting][120], [laser tube cutting][121], and [tube
bending][122] services. [Start your quote][123] or [contact us][124] today to begin.

[Xometry Resources]

## Choose Your Optimal Price and Lead Time

The [Xometry Instant Quoting Engine®][125] makes it easy to upload a CAD file and compare prices and
lead times in just a few clicks. With thousands of manufacturing suppliers in all 50 U.S. states and
more than 20 countries, Xometry’s extensive network gives you options to choose the shipping
timeline and price that fit your business and budget. 

Xometry offers [price matching][126] and a 30-day price guarantee on quotes, giving you peace of
mind that you’re getting the best price. When [ordering prototypes][127] — originals or models of
parts that are intended exclusively for non-commercial purposes — the price shown at checkout
includes tariffs. Shipping is also included, as long as your package is standard-size.

Elite Trimworks is your trusted source for premium architectural millwork, and columns. With over 20
years of experience in manufacturing high-quality cellular PVC products, we deliver durable,
low-maintenance solutions that combine style with performance.

Whether you are renovating a heritage home, upgrading a modern space, or managing a custom build, we
offer factory-direct pricing, fast shipping across North America, and free design consultations with
our expert team.

Contractors, designers, and homeowners count on Elite Trimworks for millwork that enhances curb
appeal, elevates interiors, and adds lasting value. From columns and wainscoting to mouldings and
decorative accents, every product reflects our commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and service.

Elite Trimworks is your trusted source for premium architectural millwork, and columns. With over 20
years of experience in manufacturing high-quality cellular PVC products, we deliver durable,
low-maintenance solutions that combine style with performance.

Whether you are renovating a heritage home, upgrading a modern space, or managing a custom build, we
offer factory-direct pricing, fast shipping across North America, and free design consultations with
our expert team.

Contractors, designers, and homeowners count on Elite Trimworks for millwork that enhances curb
appeal, elevates interiors, and adds lasting value. From columns and wainscoting to mouldings and
decorative accents, every product reflects our commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and service.

customers to make great products together. Our vision isn’t limited by geography: we stand ready to
serve customers anywhere on the globe. Our current focus is on energy storage for vehicles,
hand-held consumer electronics, membranes used in clothing, and extrusion systems used to
manufacture the materials that go into a myriad of consumer products. ENTEK maintains an active
research and development effort to develop new products and markets. We will enter new markets where
we can make a positive difference for our customers.

hand-held consumer electronics, membranes used in clothing, and extrusion systems used to
manufacture the materials that go into a myriad of consumer products. ENTEK maintains an active
research and development effort to develop new products and markets. We will enter new markets where
we can make a positive difference for our customers.

## [More Extruded Plastics Manufacturers][104]


### Plastic Extrusion Supplier Directory Overview

Find, compare, and connect with extruded plastic manufacturers serving a wide range of industrial
needs. This directory helps buyers browse plastic extrusion companies that produce custom profiles,
tubing, channels, strips, trim, sheet, and other extruded plastic products for automotive,
construction, electronics, medical, packaging, water treatment, and general industrial applications.
Whether you need a plastic extrusion manufacturer for standard runs or a custom plastic extrusions
manufacturer for complex shapes and material requirements, this page makes it easier to source
qualified suppliers, review capabilities, and identify plastic extrusion services aligned with your
product, process, and production goals.

### Custom Plastic Profiles and Structural Extrusions

Extruded plastic manufacturers in this directory produce custom profiles used in framing systems,
edge protection, seals, guides, and structural components. These shapes support construction,
display, transportation, and equipment applications where consistent cross-sections, dimensional
control, and repeatable output matter. Buyers comparing plastic extrusion companies often start here
when they need custom plastic extrusion companies able to match a design drawing, hold tolerances,
and support ongoing production.

### Tubing, Pipe, and Continuous Flow Extrusions

Tubing and pipe extrusions are used for fluid transfer, insulation, containment, and protective
routing. Suppliers offering these products commonly serve medical, chemical processing, water
handling, food processing, and industrial equipment markets where material performance and clean,
continuous production are critical. This is also where many buyers evaluate pvc extrusion companies
when the application requires durability, corrosion resistance, weatherability, or electrical
insulation.

### Strip, Channel, and Trim Extrusion Applications

Strip, channel, and trim extrusions support gasketing, spacing, edging, wire management, and
finishing functions across appliances, vehicles, fixtures, and retail systems. These extrusion
plastics are often selected for flexibility, rigidity, surface finish, or fit within an assembly.
Buyers looking at plastic extrusion services for these product types usually compare material
options, color matching, secondary operations, and the supplier’s ability to scale from prototype
quantities to production volumes.

### Sheet, Film, and Coextruded Plastic Products

Sheet, film, jacketing, and specialty coextruded products serve packaging, electrical, barrier, and
protective applications. In these segments, sourcing decisions often extend beyond the profile
itself to include tooling support, process control, downstream cutting, spooling, printing, and
inspection. Buyers researching plastic extrusion machine manufacturers may also be comparing the
production methods behind the parts they need, especially when output speed, multilayer
construction, or material blending affect final performance.

### Industry Applications of Extruded Plastic Products

Automotive buyers often need extruded plastic products for trim, seals, protective channels, and
tubing that can handle vibration, heat, and assembly-line consistency. Construction buyers look for
profiles, siding components, frames, and pvc extrusion options built for weather resistance and long
service life. Electronics manufacturers need wire insulation, jacketing, spacers, and housings with
dependable dimensional control. Medical and laboratory applications require tubing and custom shapes
made for clean handling and tight specifications. Packaging and processing operations depend on
film, sheet, guides, and protective profiles that support fast throughput, repeatability, and
product protection.

### Production Volume and Supplier Capability

Production volume should shape your supplier search early. Some plastic extrusion companies are best
suited for short development runs and frequent design changes, while others are built for

Extruded plastic manufacturers in this directory produce custom profiles used in framing systems,

control, and repeatable output matter. Buyers comparing plastic extrusion companies often start here
when they need custom plastic extrusion companies able to match a design drawing, hold tolerances,
and support ongoing production.

### Tubing, Pipe, and Continuous Flow Extrusions

routing. Suppliers offering these products commonly serve medical, chemical processing, water
handling, food processing, and industrial equipment markets where material performance and clean,
continuous production are critical. This is also where many buyers evaluate pvc extrusion companies

insulation.

finishing functions across appliances, vehicles, fixtures, and retail systems. These extrusion
plastics are often selected for flexibility, rigidity, surface finish, or fit within an assembly.
Buyers looking at plastic extrusion services for these product types usually compare material
options, color matching, secondary operations, and the supplier’s ability to scale from prototype
quantities to production volumes.

protective applications. In these segments, sourcing decisions often extend beyond the profile
itself to include tooling support, process control, downstream cutting, spooling, printing, and
inspection. Buyers researching plastic extrusion machine manufacturers may also be comparing the
production methods behind the parts they need, especially when output speed, multilayer
construction, or material blending affect final performance.

tubing that can handle vibration, heat, and assembly-line consistency. Construction buyers look for
profiles, siding components, frames, and pvc extrusion options built for weather resistance and long
service life. Electronics manufacturers need wire insulation, jacketing, spacers, and housings with
dependable dimensional control. Medical and laboratory applications require tubing and custom shapes
made for clean handling and tight specifications. Packaging and processing operations depend on
film, sheet, guides, and protective profiles that support fast throughput, repeatability, and
product protection.

# НОВЫЕ ГОРИЗОНТЫ
# 3D ПЕЧАТИ

Российский производитель и разработчик 3D систем

Открываем новые возможности применения аддитивных технологий
в любых отраслях промышленности, делая
3D печать любыми материалами быстрой
и качественной для каждого производителя.
Системы 3D печати компании F2 innovations имеют **[АКТ ЭКСПЕРТИЗЫ по ПП РФ № 719][62]**,
продукты находятся в реестре отечественных производителей Минпромторга РФ.

    * * * **MATERIAL SELECTION**
          We can formulate custom compounds to meet stringent and unusual requirements for our
          customers. We have access to large databases of material systems and can recommend
          materials best suited for your engineering requirements, manufacturing process, and cost
          targets.
  * [INDUSTRIAL DESIGN][8]
    * * * **INDUSTRIAL DESIGN**
          Our comprehensive CAD experience gives us confidence to transform your idea into a virtual
          model. This virtual model is the basis for the engineering and manufacturing process. We
          have expert users of the most popular CAD/PLM products and can integrate with your product
          development digital environment.
  * [DIGITAL ENGINEERING][9]
    * * * **DIGITAL ENGINEERING**
          We offer a suite of digital engineering services that enable model-based engineering
          (MBSE) and simulation of complex engineering problems. Using the latest tools and
          technologies to create simulations allows us to test and optimize products early in the
          design. This saves our customers time and money, and ensures that their innovative product
          meets the highest standards of quality and performance.
  * [RAPID PROTOTYPING][10]
    * * * **RAPID PROTOTYPING**
          If you are confident in your design but not in the volumes, we can make prototypes for

# Setting the Global Standard in Plastics Extrusion

Welcome to Graham Engineering Company – inventors of the Graham Wheel in 1964 and a global leader in
plastics extrusion innovation. For over half a century, we’ve set the benchmark for performance,
precision, and reliability in the industry.

### Engineered for Performance

At Graham Engineering, we deliver more than just machinery. We deliver custom extrusion solutions
designed to meet your exact specifications. Across our product lines, our machines are trusted
around the world for their consistent performance, reliability, and results.

Graham’s innovations produce reliable, replicable parisons and quality single screw extrusion with
the ability to seamlessly integrate downstream equipment. Our clients trust Graham because our
innovative machines – customized to precisely meet their needs – saves them time and money.

### Complete Extrusion Solutions

We serve a wide range of industries with tailored solutions including blow molding, sheet extrusion,
industrial, and medical tubing solutions. Our comprehensive systems, including fully-integrated
downstream equipment, allow our clients to reach new levels of quality and efficiency.

### A Legacy of Quality

For decades, Graham Engineering has earned the trust of clients worldwide through our steadfast
commitment to engineering excellence. We’re proud to unite the strengths of American Kuhne^{®},
Welex^{®}, and Navigator^{®} Controls – blending our heritage of quality with a focus on innovation
to create unrivaled solutions for our customers.

Our dedication doesn’t end at installation. We offer a comprehensive line of OEM spare parts,
precisely engineered to support your equipment long after the sale, reflecting our commitment to
quality and optimized performance throughout the lifetime of your machinery.

# Setting the Global Standard in Plastics Extrusion

Welcome to Graham Engineering Company – inventors of the Graham Wheel in 1964 and a global leader in
plastics extrusion innovation. For over half a century, we’ve set the benchmark for performance,
precision, and reliability in the industry.

### Engineered for Performance

At Graham Engineering, we deliver more than just machinery. We deliver custom extrusion solutions
designed to meet your exact specifications. Across our product lines, our machines are trusted
around the world for their consistent performance, reliability, and results.

Graham’s innovations produce reliable, replicable parisons and quality single screw extrusion with
the ability to seamlessly integrate downstream equipment. Our clients trust Graham because our
innovative machines – customized to precisely meet their needs – saves them time and money.

### Complete Extrusion Solutions

We serve a wide range of industries with tailored solutions including blow molding, sheet extrusion,
industrial, and medical tubing solutions. Our comprehensive systems, including fully-integrated
downstream equipment, allow our clients to reach new levels of quality and efficiency.

### A Legacy of Quality

For decades, Graham Engineering has earned the trust of clients worldwide through our steadfast
commitment to engineering excellence. We’re proud to unite the strengths of American Kuhne^{®},
Welex^{®}, and Navigator^{®} Controls – blending our heritage of quality with a focus on innovation
to create unrivaled solutions for our customers.

Our dedication doesn’t end at installation. We offer a comprehensive line of OEM spare parts,
precisely engineered to support your equipment long after the sale, reflecting our commitment to
quality and optimized performance throughout the lifetime of your machinery.

Highland Plastics specializes in custom compounds and extrusion.
Delighting our customers since 1991.

## Highland Plastics Introduces Antimony-Free Kelvinite 2100 FRPP as a Superior Alternative Amid
## China Antimony Export Ban

Highland Plastics, a leader in innovative polymer solutions, announces that its groundbreaking
Kelvinite® 2100 halogen-free flame-retardant polypropylene (HFFR PP) is perfectly positioned to meet
the critical needs of automotive suppliers and other industries affected by China’s recent ban on
antimony exports.

[Learn More][13]
[lamination_new]

### Lamination Capabilities

We have experience laminating a wide range of materials, including carpet, foam, foil, films and
engineered plastics.

[prototypes_new]

### Prototypes & Sample Runs

Do you need an R&D partner to convert your resin? We can design an economical trial schedule to meet
your needs.

[mass-loaded_new]

### Mass Loaded Materials

Our highly filled acoustic mass barriers are suitable for both automotive and non-automotive
applications.

[custom-compounding_new]

### Custom Compounding

Let us develop a formulation specific to your application.

[Compounds]

## Need Advice Choosing Suitable Materials?

We would be happy to talk to you about your specific plastic needs. Whether you are trying to create
a material to a known industry specification or want to create something that hasn’t been done
before—we can suggest a product construction that makes sense for your application.

[Contact Us With Your Request][14]

## The Perfect Blend of Expertise in Materials and Manufacturing

#### Compounding

Our compounding abilities let us fine tune a formulation specific to your application. Give yourself
an edge on your competition by developing a material with unique characteristics.

#### Extruding

Our extrusion technology supports a wide range of product constructions. From delicate multilayer
lamination, to crumb rubber conversion, to resin casting in molds—we can do it all.

thermoforming packaging machinery and becoming a trusted partner for customers seeking efficient and
scalable packaging automation solutions.

## Our Development Journey

From a small workshop to a globally recognized thermoforming packaging machinery manufacturer — our
growth story reflects relentless dedication to engineering excellence.

Founding Stage

### From Workshop to Manufacturer

In its early years, the company started as a small workshop dedicated to basic plastic forming
equipment. Through consistent investment in research and development, Switara gradually expanded its
capabilities, introducing semi-automatic thermoforming machines and improving production precision.

Growth Phase

### Full Automation & Intelligent Systems

As market demand increased, the company transitioned into fully automated thermoforming packaging
systems, integrating modern control technologies and intelligent operation features. This pivotal
shift enabled Switara to serve larger, more demanding industrial clients globally.

Maturity & Scale

### Comprehensive Production System Established

Hangzhou Switara Packing Co., Ltd. established a comprehensive production system supported by
experienced engineers, advanced manufacturing facilities, and strict quality control processes. The
company now offers customized solutions, including vacuum forming, pressure forming, and integrated
packaging lines designed to enhance productivity and reduce operational costs.

Present Day

### Global Expansion & Trusted Partnership

Today, Switara continues to expand its global presence, committed to providing high-performance
thermoforming packaging machinery and becoming a trusted partner for customers seeking efficient and
scalable packaging automation solutions across more than 50 countries worldwide.

## Core Products & Solutions

Switara offers a comprehensive portfolio of thermoforming packaging machinery engineered for
precision, efficiency, and long-term reliability across diverse industrial applications.

⚙️

### Fully Automatic Thermoforming Packaging Machines

High-speed, fully automated thermoforming systems integrating forming, filling, sealing, and cutting
processes in a single continuous production line. Ideal for large-scale industrial packaging
operations.

Flagship Product
🔩

### Semi-Automatic Thermoforming Machines

Precision-engineered semi-automatic solutions designed for flexible production environments.
Cost-effective and easy to operate, suitable for small-to-medium enterprises entering thermoforming
packaging.

Versatile
🌀

### Vacuum Forming Systems

Advanced vacuum forming machines producing precise plastic packaging components with consistent wall
thickness and excellent surface quality. Widely used in food trays, blister packs, and industrial
parts.

High Precision
💨

### Pressure Forming Systems

Pressure forming technology delivering sharper detail and tighter tolerances than standard vacuum
forming. Perfect for medical device packaging, electronics housings, and premium consumer product
packaging.

Premium Quality
🏭

### Integrated Packaging Lines

Complete end-to-end integrated packaging line solutions combining thermoforming, labeling,
inspection, and stacking. Designed to maximize throughput while minimizing labor costs and
production downtime.

Turnkey Solution
🛠️

### Custom Automation Solutions

Tailored plastic forming automation solutions engineered to specific customer requirements,
including custom mold design, specialized material handling, and bespoke control system integration.

Custom OEM

## Factory & Manufacturing Facilities

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing campus in Hangzhou, China, is equipped with advanced CNC
machining centers, precision welding stations, and automated assembly lines to ensure every machine
meets our exacting quality standards.

🏗️

### Modern Production Workshop

Over 15,000 m² of dedicated manufacturing floor space housing advanced CNC machining centers, laser
cutting equipment, and precision assembly stations for thermoforming machine production.

🔬

### R&D Innovation Center

A dedicated research and development center staffed by 30+ senior engineers continuously developing
next-generation thermoforming technologies, intelligent control systems, and energy-efficient
forming solutions.

✅

ISO-certified quality control laboratory equipped with precision measurement instruments, material
testing equipment, and full machine run-off testing facilities ensuring every unit ships
defect-free.

30+ R&D Engineers
200+ Production Staff
ISO Certified Quality

A glimpse into Switara's advanced thermoforming machine production environment — where precision
engineering meets industrial-scale manufacturing.

## Our Core Advantages

What sets Switara apart from other thermoforming packaging machine manufacturers — built on decades
of engineering expertise and customer-centric innovation.

🚀

### Advanced Technology

Proprietary intelligent control systems, servo-driven forming mechanisms, and Industry 4.0-ready
automation interfaces for maximum efficiency and precision.

🎯

### Engineering Precision

Tight manufacturing tolerances, precision-machined components, and rigorous quality inspection at
every production stage ensure consistent, reliable performance.

🔧

### Full Customization

From mold design to control software, every aspect of our thermoforming machines can be customized
to meet specific production requirements and packaging specifications.

🌍

### Global Service Network

Dedicated after-sales support teams, remote diagnostics capabilities, and a global network of
trained service engineers ensuring minimal downtime for customers worldwide.

## Why Choose Switara?

Thousands of packaging manufacturers around the world trust Switara as their long-term thermoforming
equipment partner. Here's why.

💡

### Innovation-Driven Design

Our R&D team continuously develops new forming technologies, energy-saving mechanisms, and smart
monitoring systems to keep your production line ahead of the competition.

📦

### End-to-End Solutions

From initial consultation and mold design to machine manufacturing, installation, operator training,
and ongoing maintenance — Switara provides complete lifecycle support.

⏱️

### Fast Delivery & Lead Times

With a robust supply chain, in-house component manufacturing, and efficient production scheduling,
Switara consistently delivers machines on time, even for complex custom orders.

💰

### Competitive Pricing

Direct factory pricing with no middlemen, combined with high machine durability and low maintenance
costs, delivers exceptional total cost of ownership for our customers.

🛡️

### Proven Reliability

Machines operating in demanding 24/7 production environments globally, with documented
mean-time-between-failure (MTBF) rates that consistently exceed industry benchmarks.

🤝

### Dedicated After-Sales Support

24/7 technical support hotline, rapid spare parts dispatch, on-site service visits, and remote video
assistance ensure your production operations are never interrupted for long.

## Key Certifications & Qualifications

Switara's thermoforming packaging machines are certified to meet international quality, safety, and
environmental standards — giving you confidence in every purchase.

🏆

### ISO 9001:2015

International Quality Management System certification ensuring consistent product quality, process
control, and continuous improvement across all manufacturing operations.

⚡

### CE Certification

European Conformity marking confirming all Switara thermoforming machines meet EU safety, health,
and environmental protection requirements for the European market.

🌿

### ISO 14001

Environmental Management System certification demonstrating Switara's commitment to sustainable
manufacturing practices, waste reduction, and minimizing environmental impact.

🔒

### SGS Inspection Certified

Third-party SGS quality inspection certification providing independent verification of product
quality, material specifications, and manufacturing process compliance.

## OEM & ODM Capabilities

Switara is a trusted OEM and ODM manufacturing partner for packaging equipment brands, distributors,
and system integrators worldwide. We bring your designs to life with precision and discretion.

🎨

### Custom Branding & Labeling

Full white-label OEM service with your brand name, logo, and color scheme applied to all machine
panels, documentation, and packaging materials.

📐

### Custom Mold Design

In-house mold design and manufacturing team capable of producing complex thermoforming molds to
customer specifications with rapid prototyping and short lead times.

🖥️

### Custom Control Systems

Bespoke PLC and HMI control system programming tailored to customer workflow requirements, including
custom recipe management, data logging, and remote monitoring integration.

📋

### Technical Documentation

Complete OEM technical documentation packages including operation manuals, maintenance guides, spare
parts catalogs, and electrical schematics in customer-specified languages.

Real-world applications of Switara thermoforming packaging solutions across diverse industries —

## Comprehensive Plastic Materials Inventory

From commodity plastics to high-performance engineering polymers, Laird Plastics maintains North
America's most extensive selection of plastic sheets, rods, tubes, and films. Our inventory spans
every application from aerospace components to marine fabrication, architectural glazing to food
processing equipment.

[Clear acrylic and polycarbonate sheets for displays and safety applications]

### Clear & Transparent Plastics

Our acrylic sheets and polycarbonate panels dominate transparent plastic applications. Cast acrylic
offers crystal clarity for museum displays, aquariums, and architectural glazing, while
polycarbonate provides 250 times the impact resistance of glass for machine guards, safety shields,
and bulletproof barriers. Available in clear, tinted, and UV-stabilized formulations from
manufacturers like Plaskolite, SABIC, and Röhm. PVC sheets offer economical transparency with
excellent chemical resistance for industrial applications. [Shop Clear Plastics][79]

[High-performance PEEK, Ultem, and engineering plastic materials]

### Engineering Plastics

High-performance engineering plastics including PEEK, Ultem, Torlon, acetal (Delrin), and nylon
deliver exceptional mechanical properties for demanding applications. PEEK withstands continuous
temperatures to 480°F while maintaining dimensional stability in aerospace and semiconductor
environments. Acetal offers low friction for gears and bearings. PTFE (Teflon) provides chemical
inertness and non-stick properties for chemical processing. These materials meet stringent aerospace
(AS9100), medical (USP Class VI), and industrial specifications. [Shop Engineering Materials][80]

[HDPE and UHMW polyethylene sheets for marine and industrial use]

### Polyethylene Materials

HDPE sheet provides superior chemical resistance, moisture resistance, and impact strength for
cutting boards, chemical tanks, and marine applications. UHMW (Ultra-High Molecular Weight
polyethylene) features self-lubricating properties ideal for wear strips, chute liners, and conveyor
components. Both materials are FDA compliant for food contact and USDA approved for food processing
environments. King StarBoard marine-grade HDPE resists saltwater corrosion and UV degradation for
boat fabrication and dock construction. [Shop Polyethylene][81]

[Expanded PVC foam boards and specialty plastic substrates for signage]

### Specialty & Substrate Materials

Expanded PVC foam boards, ACM (aluminum composite material) panels, and corrugated plastic sheets
serve signage, display, and architectural markets. King ColorBoard and Sintra provide lightweight,
weather-resistant substrates for outdoor signage with vibrant color retention. G-10 fiberglass
laminates offer high strength-to-weight ratios for electrical insulation and structural
applications. Static-dissipative and conductive plastics protect sensitive electronics in cleanroom
and ESD-controlled manufacturing environments. [Shop Specialty Plastics][82]

[King StarBoard marine-grade HDPE for boat and dock construction]

### Marine & Outdoor Materials

Marine-grade plastics engineered for saltwater exposure, UV stability, and extreme weather
conditions. King StarBoard HDPE is the industry standard for boat fabrication, dock construction,
and coastal applications, offering superior resistance to rot, delamination, and marine organism
attachment. UV-stabilized polycarbonate and acrylic maintain clarity and strength in outdoor
installations. These materials comply with marine industry standards and resist degradation in harsh
environments where traditional materials fail. [Shop Marine Plastics][83]

[FDA approved food-grade HDPE and plastic materials for food processing]

### Food-Grade & FDA Compliant

FDA-approved materials meeting 21 CFR 177 requirements for direct food contact include HDPE cutting
boards, UHMW conveyor components, polypropylene food containers, and NSF-certified materials for
commercial kitchens and food processing facilities. These plastics resist bacterial growth,
withstand commercial sanitization cycles, and maintain compliance with USDA and FDA regulations.
Available in natural colors and thicknesses suitable for cutting surfaces, food processing
equipment, and packaging applications. [Shop Food-Grade Plastics][84]

## Comprehensive Plastic Materials Inventory

From commodity plastics to high-performance engineering polymers, Laird Plastics maintains North
America's most extensive selection of plastic sheets, rods, tubes, and films. Our inventory spans
every application from aerospace components to marine fabrication, architectural glazing to food
processing equipment.

[Clear acrylic and polycarbonate sheets for displays and safety applications]

### Clear & Transparent Plastics

Our acrylic sheets and polycarbonate panels dominate transparent plastic applications. Cast acrylic
offers crystal clarity for museum displays, aquariums, and architectural glazing, while
polycarbonate provides 250 times the impact resistance of glass for machine guards, safety shields,
and bulletproof barriers. Available in clear, tinted, and UV-stabilized formulations from
manufacturers like Plaskolite, SABIC, and Röhm. PVC sheets offer economical transparency with
excellent chemical resistance for industrial applications. [Shop Clear Plastics][79]

[High-performance PEEK, Ultem, and engineering plastic materials]

### Engineering Plastics

High-performance engineering plastics including PEEK, Ultem, Torlon, acetal (Delrin), and nylon
deliver exceptional mechanical properties for demanding applications. PEEK withstands continuous
temperatures to 480°F while maintaining dimensional stability in aerospace and semiconductor
environments. Acetal offers low friction for gears and bearings. PTFE (Teflon) provides chemical
inertness and non-stick properties for chemical processing. These materials meet stringent aerospace
(AS9100), medical (USP Class VI), and industrial specifications. [Shop Engineering Materials][80]

[HDPE and UHMW polyethylene sheets for marine and industrial use]

### Polyethylene Materials

HDPE sheet provides superior chemical resistance, moisture resistance, and impact strength for
cutting boards, chemical tanks, and marine applications. UHMW (Ultra-High Molecular Weight
polyethylene) features self-lubricating properties ideal for wear strips, chute liners, and conveyor
components. Both materials are FDA compliant for food contact and USDA approved for food processing
environments. King StarBoard marine-grade HDPE resists saltwater corrosion and UV degradation for
boat fabrication and dock construction. [Shop Polyethylene][81]

[Expanded PVC foam boards and specialty plastic substrates for signage]

### Specialty & Substrate Materials

Expanded PVC foam boards, ACM (aluminum composite material) panels, and corrugated plastic sheets
serve signage, display, and architectural markets. King ColorBoard and Sintra provide lightweight,
weather-resistant substrates for outdoor signage with vibrant color retention. G-10 fiberglass
laminates offer high strength-to-weight ratios for electrical insulation and structural
applications. Static-dissipative and conductive plastics protect sensitive electronics in cleanroom
and ESD-controlled manufacturing environments. [Shop Specialty Plastics][82]

[King StarBoard marine-grade HDPE for boat and dock construction]

### Marine & Outdoor Materials

Marine-grade plastics engineered for saltwater exposure, UV stability, and extreme weather
conditions. King StarBoard HDPE is the industry standard for boat fabrication, dock construction,
and coastal applications, offering superior resistance to rot, delamination, and marine organism
attachment. UV-stabilized polycarbonate and acrylic maintain clarity and strength in outdoor
installations. These materials comply with marine industry standards and resist degradation in harsh
environments where traditional materials fail. [Shop Marine Plastics][83]

[FDA approved food-grade HDPE and plastic materials for food processing]

### Food-Grade & FDA Compliant

FDA-approved materials meeting 21 CFR 177 requirements for direct food contact include HDPE cutting
boards, UHMW conveyor components, polypropylene food containers, and NSF-certified materials for
commercial kitchens and food processing facilities. These plastics resist bacterial growth,
withstand commercial sanitization cycles, and maintain compliance with USDA and FDA regulations.
Available in natural colors and thicknesses suitable for cutting surfaces, food processing
equipment, and packaging applications. [Shop Food-Grade Plastics][84]

### Who we are

### FROM HUMBLE BEGINNINGS TO WORLD CLASS

Forty years ago, a driven entrepreneur started a film converting and distribution business built on
customer service and quality. From John Parsio, Sr.’s single slitter operation, Multi-Plastics has
become a global leader.

[ About Us ][42]

### What we do

### MANUFACTURER. CONVERTER. DISTRIBUTOR.

With technology-driven product performance, Multi-Plastics has become a leader in plastic film roll
slitting and sheet converting with global reach. With proprietary extrusion lines, we can meet your
film solution needs.

[ Our Capabilities ][43]

### Who we serve

### OUR MARKETS & FILM SOLUTION APPLICATIONS

We provide film application solutions from short-run to full scale across the envelope, tag & label,
folding carton, sheet-fed and specialty markets.

## OUR SERVICES + CAPABILITIES

### Multi-Plastics is a full-service, vertically integrated company. From polymerization and
### extrusion, to roll slitting and sheet converting, to global distribution... we've got you
### covered.

[
][58]

### Manufacturing

Multi-Plastics Extrusions, acquired in 2010, offers expert custom extruded OPS, PET, and PP films
for various applications. With ten extrusion lines and our Hazleton, PA polymerization facility,
plus an in-house R&D lab, we have the technical expertise to stay at the forefront of film extrusion
while meeting market cost demands.
* [ Learn more about Sheet & Film Extrusion ][59]

[
][60]

### Converting

Multi-Plastics produces over three million pounds of plastic films monthly from six North American
and one European facility. With over twenty-five slitting assets worldwide, we can handle any scale,
from a single roll to truckload quantities. You can trust our team to meet your needs.
* [ Learn more about Custom Roll Slitting ][61]
* [ Learn more about Sheet Converting ][62]

[
][63]

### Lab Services & Capabilities

Since 1979, Multi-Plastics has partnered with leading manufacturers to distribute custom plastic
films from seven global facilities. We offer tailored solutions and precision slitting and sheeting
to meet market demands. Converting over 3 million pounds of films monthly, with more than 75%
shipping within 3 days, we provide efficient distribution solutions for your unique needs.
* [ Learn more about our Lab Services & Capabilities ][64]

[
][65]

### Global Distribution

Our global reach includes six North American converting facilities (each over 45,000 sq. ft.), one
converting and distribution facility in England, and three international warehouse partnerships.
* [ Learn more about Global Distribution ][66]

# We are a global film manufacturer


#### We are vertically integrated


# Short run to full scale


#### From manufacturing to global distribution


# we provide film process solutions


### Who we are

### FROM HUMBLE BEGINNINGS TO WORLD CLASS

Forty years ago, a driven entrepreneur started a film converting and distribution business built on
customer service and quality. From John Parsio, Sr.’s single slitter operation, Multi-Plastics has
become a global leader.

[ About Us ][42]

### What we do

### MANUFACTURER. CONVERTER. DISTRIBUTOR.

With technology-driven product performance, Multi-Plastics has become a leader in plastic film roll
slitting and sheet converting with global reach. With proprietary extrusion lines, we can meet your
film solution needs.

[ Our Capabilities ][43]

### Who we serve

### OUR MARKETS & FILM SOLUTION APPLICATIONS

We provide film application solutions from short-run to full scale across the envelope, tag & label,
folding carton, sheet-fed and specialty markets.

[ Markets & Applications ][44]

## OUR PRODUCTS + FILM SOLUTIONS

### We provide film process solutions from short run to full scale

### Health & Beauty Aid

### Industrial

## OUR SERVICES + CAPABILITIES

### Multi-Plastics is a full-service, vertically integrated company. From polymerization and
### extrusion, to roll slitting and sheet converting, to global distribution... we've got you
### covered.

[
][58]

### Manufacturing

Multi-Plastics Extrusions, acquired in 2010, offers expert custom extruded OPS, PET, and PP films
for various applications. With ten extrusion lines and our Hazleton, PA polymerization facility,
plus an in-house R&D lab, we have the technical expertise to stay at the forefront of film extrusion
while meeting market cost demands.
* [ Learn more about Sheet & Film Extrusion ][59]

[
][60]

### Converting

Multi-Plastics produces over three million pounds of plastic films monthly from six North American
and one European facility. With over twenty-five slitting assets worldwide, we can handle any scale,
from a single roll to truckload quantities. You can trust our team to meet your needs.
* [ Learn more about Custom Roll Slitting ][61]
* [ Learn more about Sheet Converting ][62]

[
][63]

### Lab Services & Capabilities

Since 1979, Multi-Plastics has partnered with leading manufacturers to distribute custom plastic
films from seven global facilities. We offer tailored solutions and precision slitting and sheeting
to meet market demands. Converting over 3 million pounds of films monthly, with more than 75%
shipping within 3 days, we provide efficient distribution solutions for your unique needs.
* [ Learn more about our Lab Services & Capabilities ][64]

[
][65]

### Global Distribution

Our global reach includes six North American converting facilities (each over 45,000 sq. ft.), one
converting and distribution facility in England, and three international warehouse partnerships.
* [ Learn more about Global Distribution ][66]

## Questions?

### Our team of experts is ready to help!

* [ Find your nearest agent or distributor ][68]

### Quality Through Innovation

Our ongoing reinvestment in our extrusion and downstream equipment is a cornerstone of our
commitment to excellence and innovation. By upgrading our machinery, controls, and support systems,
we ensure that our production capabilities remain aligned with the latest advancements in extrusion
technology. This proactive approach not only enhances our efficiency and precision but also allows
us to respond effectively to the evolving demands of the plastics industry. By staying ahead of
technological trends and investing in cutting-edge solutions, we’re able to offer our customers
greater flexibility, improved product quality, and faster turnaround times—all while maintaining the
high standards they’ve come to expect from us.

[Our Facility][48]

### Consistency Through Standardization

Our commitment to quality is reflected in the continuous review and refinement of our processes and
procedures. We understand that delivering a superior extruded product requires more than just
technical expertise—it demands ongoing attention to detail, innovation, and responsiveness to our
customers’ needs. That’s why we regularly evaluate every step of our production process, from raw
material handling and extrusion parameters to final inspection and packaging, to ensure optimal
performance and consistency. Our goal is to not only meet your expectations but to exceed them with
every order.

[SOP]
[Decorative: Image Accent]

### Sustainability

Transforming by-products into new products is a key element of our manufacturing process. We are
dedicated to recycling non-conforming products as part of our ongoing efforts to minimize our carbon
footprint. Therefore, a significant portion of our product lines can be manufactured from
Post-Industrial Recyclate (PIR). This recyclate is derived from by- products of the plastics
industry, providing a sustainable and practical alternative to virgin materials.

Learn more about our efforts to integrate sustainable practices into our plastic extrusion
processes, fostering a more environmentally responsible approach to manufacturing.

[Learn More][49]

greater flexibility, improved product quality, and faster turnaround times—all while maintaining the

procedures. We understand that delivering a superior extruded product requires more than just
technical expertise—it demands ongoing attention to detail, innovation, and responsiveness to our
customers’ needs. That’s why we regularly evaluate every step of our production process, from raw
material handling and extrusion parameters to final inspection and packaging, to ensure optimal
performance and consistency. Our goal is to not only meet your expectations but to exceed them with
every order.

Post-Industrial Recyclate (PIR). This recyclate is derived from by- products of the plastics
industry, providing a sustainable and practical alternative to virgin materials.

How to Set Up Your Trolley case/ Luggage/ Suitcase Production Line
In the world of suitcase/luggage/trolley case  manufacturing, choosing the right materials and
production processes is paramount. The decision between using forming ABS/PC (Acrylonitrile
Butadiene Styrene/Polycarbonate) or injecting PP (Polypropylene) can significantly impact both the
quality and cost-effectiveness of your luggage products. This article delves into how to set up an
efficient suitcase production line, focusing on these two primary methods, while providing valuable
insights for buyers, as well as maintenance advice for the equipment used. Property  PP PC ABS
Weight  Light  Light  Heavier  Durability  Moderate Flexible but prone to deformation under heavy
stress  Excellent High impact resistance, withstands rough handling and drops  Good Rigid and
sturdy, but less impact resistance than PC  Heat resistance  Poor Softens at high temperatures at
100℃ High  Retains shape up to -120℃ Moderate  can warp at 90 ℃ Scratch resistance  Low Easily

and scuffs  Flexibility  High High weak Cost  Lowest  Highest  Mid-range  Aesthetic  Matte finish 
Limited color/shine options  Glossy finish Sleek, modern look with transparency options  Smooth
finish  Easily laminated for vibrant design  Cold resistance  Good  Performs well in cold
conditions  Excellent  Retains toughness even in freezing temperatures  Poor  Becomes brittle in
extreme cold  Enviromental  Recyclable  Recyclable  Recyclable  Material Considerations: ABS/PC vs.
PP When it comes to suitcase manufacturing, material choice is crucial in determining the final
product's durability, weight, aesthetics, and cost. ABS/PC (Acrylonitrile Butadiene
Styrene/Polycarbonate) Forming: ABS and PC are widely preferred in high-end luggage due to their
excellent impact resistance and aesthetic appeal. ABS provides a sturdy shell, while PC enhances
toughness and scratch resistance. The combination leads to a premium feel that many consumers
desire. Forming these materials involves heating the plastic sheets until malleable and then shaping
them into the required form through vacuum or pressure. PP (Polypropylene) Injection Molding: PP is
favored for its cost efficiency and lightweight characteristics. It offers decent impact resistance
and flexibility, which makes it suitable for budget-friendly luggage. Injection molding of PP
involves melting the plastic, injecting it into a mold, and then cooling it to form a solid shape.
This method allows for intricate designs and rapid production cycles. Setting Up Your Suitcase
Production Line 1. Initial Planning and Research Before setting up a production line, thorough
market research is essential. Understanding demand trends, target demographics, and competitor
analyses will influence the choice between ABS/PC and PP. Consider the long-term cost implications,
including raw material costs, production speeds, and potential market prices. 2. Choosing the Right
Equipment For ABS/PC Forming: Invest in high-quality extruder sheet machines to ensure consistent
and reliable production of uniform plastic sheets that form the foundation of your products. Luggage
vacuum forming machines are crucial for shaping these sheets into precise, durable components that
meet exact design specifications. CNC cutting machines are indispensable for providing precise
cutting and trimming capabilities, which not only ensure minimal material waste but also deliver

excellent impact resistance and aesthetic appeal. ABS provides a sturdy shell, while PC enhances
toughness and scratch resistance. The combination leads to a premium feel that many consumers
desire. Forming these materials involves heating the plastic sheets until malleable and then shaping
them into the required form through vacuum or pressure. PP (Polypropylene) Injection Molding: PP is
favored for its cost efficiency and lightweight characteristics. It offers decent impact resistance
and flexibility, which makes it suitable for budget-friendly luggage. Injection molding of PP
involves melting the plastic, injecting it into a mold, and then cooling it to form a solid shape.
This method allows for intricate designs and rapid production cycles. Setting Up Your Suitcase

Zhongshan Goodlife Sun Sheet Co., Ltd., established in 2000, is a leading foreign-invested
enterprise in China specializing in high-quality Polycarbonate panels and endurance panels. With
over HKD 100 million invested in state-of-the-art production equipment from OMIPA (Italy) and
premium raw materials from Bayer (Germany), we deliver exceptional products that meet global
standards.

Our certifications include [IS09001:2015][32], [ASTM][33], [ROHS][34] and many more, ensuring
top-tier quality, environmental compliance, and performance. With a strong commitment to innovation
and excellence, we serve a wide network of customers both domestically and internationally.

[Learn More About Us][35]

### [Our Products][36]

### [We are the industry heads and use Bayer UV and Bayer or Sabic polycarbonate materials for our
### products][37]

#### [Polycarbonate sheets][38]

We offer a range of [polycarbonate hollow sheets][39], [solid sheets][40], [embossed sheets][41] and
[corrugated sheets][42], designed to meet diverse needs and applications.

#### [Functional polycarbonate sheets][43]

Including: [Anti-fog Sheets][44], [Light Diffusing Sheets][45], [Temperature Regulating Sheets][46],
[Crystal Sheets][47]

#### [Polycarbonate accessories][48]

[U-profiles & Gaskets][50], Screws etc.
