special requests for our clear boxes. Now, TRANSPACK has been manufacturing clear box packaging,
macaron tray, fruit container and blister packaging over 16 years, owned 3 factories for the
production, exporting more than 40 countries in the world. Our clear PVC box packaging has soft,
easy to fold creasing for automated assembly and nice square corners. Starting with clear plastic
sheets, we can then decorate the carton with offset printing, silk screen printing and hot stamping
printing. And we supply plastic packaging solutions for variety of Food, Gifts, Cosmetics, Health
and beauty, Electronics and Garments. TRANSPACK always believe that the packaging is one of critical
components of the products. And Clear plastic boxes provides a better way to showcase your products

company or a large corporation, we are excited to work with you. We do more than packaging, and
package your brand. ONE STOP PACKAGING SERVICE: We are a complete one-stop packaging solution
manufacturer, from the creative design, raw material, printing, die cutting, packing and door to
door shipping service. All the clear acetate boxes can be customized by your requirements.
Professional design team will provide free drawing by your request if you could give all the details
of the packaging. And the completed drawing would be sent for final confirmation before the
production. There will be Air and ocean shipping option according to your orders. We will track your
order in real time, you only need to wait for the orders at home. OUR WORKSHOP: Transpack owns the
dust-free workshop for the production, best choice for the food grade request from the customers.
Strict quality control from the raw material resourcing, mass production and the packing. And all
the packaging made of 100% food grade PET material, Widely used for the food products pack, already
passed the SGS certificate. Professional equipment UV 7+1 Heidelberg printing machine to acheive
good quality for the printing of the plastic packaging boxes. TRANSPACK has ability to do custom
printing prefect when customers request the offset printing, silk screen printing, or hot stamping
printing. There are 6 more production lines for the   production in our factory, 150,000 pcs 
 production volume per day. Transpack owns Fully Automatic Gluing   machine, great proudction rate
with low   error. It will greatly save a lot production   time and cut the cost down. WAREHOUSING
PROGRAM: TRANSPACK has over 3,000 products in stock and 2000 square-feet of warehouse space. We have
enough space to store your products and put them in the right place Our clean, dry, temperature
controlled warehouse is available to hold your boxes until you’re ready to release them. CANTON
FAIR: Our team has participated in the Canton Fair with rich experience,  can be a great way to
communicate with the customers and build relationships in the future. Also, it helps us understand
the needs on the market and produce the right packaging that you really want. You will have a good
understanding of product varieties, specifications, grades, appearance, texture, performance if you
would like to come for us.

About Us
Founded in 2005, TRANSPACK got its start as a eight-person plastic packaging business. Back then,
our customers were so impressed with our clear plastic boxes and service that they began making
special requests for our clear boxes. Now, TRANSPACK has been manufacturing clear box packaging,
macaron tray, fruit container and blister packaging over 16 years, owned 3 factories for the
production, exporting more than 40 countries in the world. Our clear PVC box packaging has soft,
easy to fold creasing for automated assembly and nice square corners. Starting with clear plastic
sheets, we can then decorate the carton with offset printing, silk screen printing and hot stamping
printing. And we supply plastic packaging solutions for variety of Food, Gifts, Cosmetics, Health
and beauty, Electronics and Garments. TRANSPACK always believe that the packaging is one of critical
components of the products. And Clear plastic boxes provides a better way to showcase your products
and increase the sales. We care for your products, just like you do. Whether you are a start-up
company or a large corporation, we are excited to work with you. We do more than packaging, and
package your brand. ONE STOP PACKAGING SERVICE: We are a complete one-stop packaging solution
manufacturer, from the creative design, raw material, printing, die cutting, packing and door to
door shipping service. All the clear acetate boxes can be customized by your requirements.
Professional design team will provide free drawing by your request if you could give all the details
of the packaging. And the completed drawing would be sent for final confirmation before the
production. There will be Air and ocean shipping option according to your orders. We will track your
order in real time, you only need to wait for the orders at home. OUR WORKSHOP: Transpack owns the
dust-free workshop for the production, best choice for the food grade request from the customers.
Strict quality control from the raw material resourcing, mass production and the packing. And all
the packaging made of 100% food grade PET material, Widely used for the food products pack, already
passed the SGS certificate. Professional equipment UV 7+1 Heidelberg printing machine to acheive
good quality for the printing of the plastic packaging boxes. TRANSPACK has ability to do custom
printing prefect when customers request the offset printing, silk screen printing, or hot stamping
printing. There are 6 more production lines for the   production in our factory, 150,000 pcs 
 production volume per day. Transpack owns Fully Automatic Gluing   machine, great proudction rate
with low   error. It will greatly save a lot production   time and cut the cost down. WAREHOUSING
PROGRAM: TRANSPACK has over 3,000 products in stock and 2000 square-feet of warehouse space. We have
enough space to store your products and put them in the right place Our clean, dry, temperature
controlled warehouse is available to hold your boxes until you’re ready to release them. CANTON
FAIR: Our team has participated in the Canton Fair with rich experience,  can be a great way to
communicate with the customers and build relationships in the future. Also, it helps us understand
the needs on the market and produce the right packaging that you really want. You will have a good
understanding of product varieties, specifications, grades, appearance, texture, performance if you
would like to come for us.

Professional engineering software for design, simulation, analysis and optimization of metal
deformation processes
[-]
Boost your production, reduce cost, extend your product range — QForm it!

QForm UK is a universal program trusted and widely used by researchers, scientists, industrial
engineers, and technical specialists. By using accurate numerical simulation, users can predict
material flow, final geometry, defects, loads, and process limits at early design stages. This
significantly reduces the need for costly physical trials, shortens development time, improves
product quality, and increases tool life. Various metal products developed with the help of QForm UK
are now used in components and systems that form an integral part of our everyday life.

Technology validation and finalization
Increasing tool life
Predicting defects and structural properties
Quick generation of reports in visual or tables form
Reducing design time
Equipment selection
Design and simulation with a flexible API and machine learning features

QForm UK is designed for cold, warm, and hot die forging, open-die forging, rolling, profile
extrusion, and other specific metal forming processes. The software can be extended with a variety
of specialized modules, including microstructure prediction, heat treatment simulation, and
user-defined subroutines. A lot of advanced capabilities are implemented through a flexible API,
allowing users to customize the program for specific technological tasks and research needs.

19.06.2026
[QForm Team took part in CastForge 2026 in Stuttgart, Germany ][17]

QForm UK team participated in [CastForge 2026, held on June 9–11 in Stuttgart, Germany][18]. The
exhibition brought together companies and specialists from the casting, forging, and metal
processing industries.

CastForge remains an important meeting place for the forging industry, and we were pleased to be
part of it again this year. Thank you to everyone who visited our stand. We look forward to seeing
you at the next CastForge exhibition.

28.05.2026
[Micas Simulations at ESAFORM 2026: presentations, discussions, and Gold sponsorship ][19]

From 27 to 29 April 2026 the 29th annual ESAFORM conference (European Scientific Association for
Material Forming) took place in the historic and vibrant city of Thessaloniki, Greece. Micas
Simulations Ltd participated as a Gold Sponsor and joined researchers and industry experts from
across Europe.

Nikolay Biba and Polina Shtolina‑Biba represented Micas Simulations at scientific talks and
networking meetings

Nikolay Biba delivered two presentations:
* An AI-based approach to developing a microstructural model for multi-stage hot deformation
  processes;
* Charge weld evolution in profile extrusion: variability across billets and multi-profile designs.

27.05.2026
[QForm UK User Meeting in Germany: “Need for Speed” at the Nationales AutoMuseum ][20]

Every two years, Dr.-Ing. Hans-Willi Raedt organizes a meeting for QForm UK users — and this time,
the event was a great success: nearly 40 participants attended to share their experiences and
explore the software’s new features.

The event program included:

• An overview of new features in QForm UK version 12

• Hands-on workshops with a detailed introduction to special functions

• Presentations on various topics from the world of QForm UK

• 7 presentations by enthusiastic users who shared real-world case studies and best practices

05.05.2026
[Wire and Tube Fair 2026: QForm UK solutions for Copper and Aluminum alloy wire industry ][21]

At the wire and Tube trade fair, held in Düsseldorf in April 2026, the [QForm Group as Micas
Simulations Ltd.][22] and [prosimalys GmbH][23] participated with a booth and showed to the industry
the benefits of simulating various metal forming processes using QForm UK software.

The wire manufacturing industry is currently growing rapidly and this is particularly evident at
events such as Wire & Tube.

13.03.2026
[You're welcome to our webinars! ][24]

As part of the QForm Academy, we have prepared eight webinars for you.

These cover the most popular topics, such as APIs and report generation, as well as all-new cases,
including wire drawing simulation, sheet rolling, and Conform extrusion, along with an overview of
our new ExtrusionLink solution for extruder and die manufacturers.

Registration is open — welcome!

02.03.2026
[QForm UK Extrusion Seminar, Japan, 2026 ][25]

In February, the QForm Group team, together with our distributors Applied Design Analysis
Corporation (ADA), held a seminar on extrusion simulation. The event covered a wide range of topics:
from reviewing real-world cases on improving extrusion processes and using the API for resource
savings to efficient profile heating in QForm UK.

Our team would like to express our sincere gratitude to all participants for their interest in
simulation and extrusion technologies. We were delighted to answer all your questions!

engineers, and technical specialists. By using accurate numerical simulation, users can predict
material flow, final geometry, defects, loads, and process limits at early design stages. This
significantly reduces the need for costly physical trials, shortens development time, improves
product quality, and increases tool life. Various metal products developed with the help of QForm UK
are now used in components and systems that form an integral part of our everyday life.

19.06.2026
[QForm Team took part in CastForge 2026 in Stuttgart, Germany ][17]

QForm UK team participated in [CastForge 2026, held on June 9–11 in Stuttgart, Germany][18]. The
exhibition brought together companies and specialists from the casting, forging, and metal
processing industries.

CastForge remains an important meeting place for the forging industry, and we were pleased to be
part of it again this year. Thank you to everyone who visited our stand. We look forward to seeing
you at the next CastForge exhibition.

28.05.2026
[Micas Simulations at ESAFORM 2026: presentations, discussions, and Gold sponsorship ][19]

From 27 to 29 April 2026 the 29th annual ESAFORM conference (European Scientific Association for
Material Forming) took place in the historic and vibrant city of Thessaloniki, Greece. Micas
Simulations Ltd participated as a Gold Sponsor and joined researchers and industry experts from
across Europe.

Nikolay Biba and Polina Shtolina‑Biba represented Micas Simulations at scientific talks and
networking meetings

Nikolay Biba delivered two presentations:
* An AI-based approach to developing a microstructural model for multi-stage hot deformation
  processes;
* Charge weld evolution in profile extrusion: variability across billets and multi-profile designs.

27.05.2026
[QForm UK User Meeting in Germany: “Need for Speed” at the Nationales AutoMuseum ][20]

Every two years, Dr.-Ing. Hans-Willi Raedt organizes a meeting for QForm UK users — and this time,
the event was a great success: nearly 40 participants attended to share their experiences and
explore the software’s new features.

The event program included:

• An overview of new features in QForm UK version 12

• Hands-on workshops with a detailed introduction to special functions

• Presentations on various topics from the world of QForm UK

• 7 presentations by enthusiastic users who shared real-world case studies and best practices

05.05.2026
[Wire and Tube Fair 2026: QForm UK solutions for Copper and Aluminum alloy wire industry ][21]

At the wire and Tube trade fair, held in Düsseldorf in April 2026, the [QForm Group as Micas
Simulations Ltd.][22] and [prosimalys GmbH][23] participated with a booth and showed to the industry
the benefits of simulating various metal forming processes using QForm UK software.

The wire manufacturing industry is currently growing rapidly and this is particularly evident at
events such as Wire & Tube.

13.03.2026
[You're welcome to our webinars! ][24]

As part of the QForm Academy, we have prepared eight webinars for you.

These cover the most popular topics, such as APIs and report generation, as well as all-new cases,
including wire drawing simulation, sheet rolling, and Conform extrusion, along with an overview of
our new ExtrusionLink solution for extruder and die manufacturers.

Registration is open — welcome!

02.03.2026
[QForm UK Extrusion Seminar, Japan, 2026 ][25]

In February, the QForm Group team, together with our distributors Applied Design Analysis
Corporation (ADA), held a seminar on extrusion simulation. The event covered a wide range of topics:
from reviewing real-world cases on improving extrusion processes and using the API for resource
savings to efficient profile heating in QForm UK.

Our team would like to express our sincere gratitude to all participants for their interest in
simulation and extrusion technologies. We were delighted to answer all your questions!

## Custom Thermoforming Solutions

### We Extrude Our Own Materials And SAVE YOU MONEY!

[
About Us
][8]


### Spencer Industries is your complete plastic product provider

We produce everything from the simplest Vacuum-Formed part to high esthetic, detailed
Pressure-Formed parts including award-winning Twin Sheet Thermoformed products.

The list of products we create and industries we serve is ever growing and includes transportation,
refrigeration, agriculture, industrial, utility vehicles, and medical carts. If you would like to
learn more about thermoforming, please feel free to [contact us today][9].

## We are a Vertically Integrated Thermoforming Leader with In-house Extrusion & Extrusion Film
## Lamination Capability.

Spencer Industries is a leader in the custom thermoforming industry and has been since 1969. We
excel at various plastics manufacturing processes including twin sheeting, thermoforming, and vacuum
forming. Our in-house team of engineers work with you to create custom thermoforming solutions that
suit your unique needs.

 

[
CLICK HERE TO LEARN MORE
][17]


### ENGINEERINGAT SPENCER INDUSTRIES

**Spencer Industries** is supported by a dedicated team of Project, Design and Manufacturing
Engineers who guide your thermoforming program from initial concept through full production and
ongoing maintenance. We work side-by-side with customers to deliver high-quality plastic
thermoforming solutions, managing every stage — conceptual design, prototyping, tool machining,
first article approval, and full production launch.

[
LEARN MORE
][18]
[ENGINEERING AT SPENCER INDUSTRIES]
[Extrusion at Spencer Industries]


### extrusionat spencer industries

Spencer Industries’ vertical integration gives us complete control over material production from
start to finish. With three in-house extrusion lines, we process ABS, TPO, HDPE, and HIPS, with
co-extrusion capabilities available to meet advanced performance and aesthetic requirements.

[
LEARN MORE
][19]


### Thermoforming & CNC Trimmingat spencer industries

Spencer Industries is a leader in the custom thermoforming industry dating back to 1969. We have 4
locations to support you; IN (HQ), SC, IA and OH.  Our in-house team of Regional Sales Managers and
Project/Design Engineers collaborate with our customers to create custom thermoforming solutions
that suit each customer’s unique needs.

pads, and interlocking skating panels – all made of high-performance PE materials. These products
leverage UHMWPE’s exceptional toughness and abrasion resistance (up to 8× that of steel) and HDPE’s

# Anodizing

Etching capabilities in Clear, Gold, Bronze, Black and Champagne for lengths up to 30 feet. Bright
Dip capabilities in Silver, Gold, Bronze, Black, Champagne and Platinum (Brushed Nickel) for lengths
up to 30 feet.

[Learn more][55]
* [Western Extrusions]
* [Extrusion]
[Previous][56][Next][57]

# Painting

**Western** operates a horizontal paint line in lengths up to 30 feet utilizing Kynar and Polyester
paints. The electrostatic spray applicationensures quality coating for the **extruded product.**

[Learn more][58]

# Thermal Barriers

**Western Extrusions** also provides pour and debridge capabilities. This process is used in the
manufacture of **aluminum** thermal barrier windows and doors. We break the continuity of the
framing profiles using a low conductivity polyurethane resin which is poured into an **extrusion**
cavity and when hardened the base of the cavity is debridged, resulting in a composite extrusion
which performs as a single structural entity. The resultant thermal bridge separating the interior
and exterior of the frame has excellent energy conservation properties and will substantially reduce
condensation or frost formation.

[Learn more][59]

# Painting

**Western** operates a horizontal paint line in lengths up to 30 feet utilizing Kynar and Polyester
paints. The electrostatic spray applicationensures quality coating for the **extruded product.**

[Learn more][58]

# Thermal Barriers

**Western Extrusions** also provides pour and debridge capabilities. This process is used in the
manufacture of **aluminum** thermal barrier windows and doors. We break the continuity of the
framing profiles using a low conductivity polyurethane resin which is poured into an **extrusion**
cavity and when hardened the base of the cavity is debridged, resulting in a composite extrusion
which performs as a single structural entity. The resultant thermal bridge separating the interior
and exterior of the frame has excellent energy conservation properties and will substantially reduce
condensation or frost formation.

[Learn more][59]

## [Algeria 75-125mm Three-Layer PPR Pipe Co-Extrusion Line][120]

Technology Empowers Overseas Infrastructure: in 2025, Yongte delivered a complete solution for
75-125mm three-layer PPR pipe extrusion lines to Algeria customer, covering full lifecycle support
from R&D, manufacturing, logistics, on-site implementation to after-sales service.

[[Canada WPC Complete Plant for Recycling Waste Fiberglass into WPC Decking]][121]

## [Canada WPC Complete Plant for Recycling Waste Fiberglass into WPC Decking][122]

Yongte's Complete Wood Plastic Composite WPC machine, tailored for recycling waste fiberglass into
high-performance composite decking, has been successfully delivered to Canada, offering a turnkey,
eco-efficient solution for sustainable building material production. It integrates waste fiberglass
into WPC decking via advanced co-extrusion, enabling resource reuse, energy savings, and
long-lasting, low-maintenance end products. The WPC complete plant includes WPC mixing machine, WPC
granulation machine, WPC decking co-extrusion machine, embossing machine, and sanding brushing
machine.

[[4-Cavity Recycled Plastic Profile Production Line for Jordan]][123]

## [4-Cavity Recycled Plastic Profile Production Line for Jordan][124]

Yongte successfully completed factory acceptance testing, trial operation and customized
commissioning for a full-set 4-cavity plastic profile production line, and officially shipped the
complete equipment to Jordan.

[[210mm Parallel Twin-Screw Recycling Extruder Delivered to Africa]][125]

## [210mm Parallel Twin-Screw Recycling Extruder Delivered to Africa][126]

Yongte 210mm Parallel Twin-Screw Recycling Extruder Delivered to African Plastic Recycler, All core
mechanical components, electrical control cabinets and heating modules of the 210mm parallel
twin-screw recycling extruder have finished manufacturing and passed strict factory inspection.
Yongte’s professional engineering team is carrying out systematic assembly, joint debugging and
full-load performance testing. The equipment will complete formal factory acceptance soon and be
shipped to Africa as scheduled to support the client’s official mass production launch.

[[Rubber Irrigation Seepage Pipe Production Line For Indian Client]][127]

## [Rubber Irrigation Seepage Pipe Production Line For Indian Client][128]

Yongte Rubber Irrigation Seepage Pipe Production Line For Indian Client adopts recycled waste tire
